description: This source file defines an Express.js route handler for the '/api/execute' endpoint, which performs an action based on the authenticated user's subscription plan. It handles user authentication, fetches user data from a Sequelize ORM model, and returns different responses depending on the plan type (normal, premium, ultra).

methods.name: POST /
methods.description: Handles POST requests to the '/api/execute' endpoint; fetches user info and returns plan-specific responses.
